resource_limitations: Sequential Mac workers; full parent plus waited-child CPU includes metadata, acquisition, failed trials and final checks. Process-group RSS and disk guards poll and may overshoot. Detached/unwaited descendant CPU is not qualified. Final receipt writes are included in acceptance caps.
resource_accounting_point: Stored totals precede final receipt publication and freshness recheck; acceptance caps include both. Enclosing experimental arms charge the entire invocation.
